# General Cross-Cutting Checklist: Todo CRUD (Add, View, Toggle, Delete)

**Purpose**: Broad requirements-quality sweep across spec.md and plan.md — scope, edge cases, assumptions, consistency, and traceability — not a deep dive into any single area.
**Created**: 2026-09-19
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) / [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are requirements defined for how the system should behave if the SQLite database file is unavailable or locked when a request is made? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK002 Does the spec define what should happen when a toggle request asks for a status the todo is already in (e.g., marking an already-complete todo complete again)? [Gap, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK003 Does the spec define how the user is meant to perceive a successful add/toggle/delete, beyond "the list updates"? [Gap, Spec §FR-001, FR-006, FR-007]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK004 Is the "reasonable maximum title length" mentioned in spec.md's Assumptions tied to one authoritative number, consistent with data-model.md's 200-character limit? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK005 Is "a consistent order" for the todo list clarified as specifically creation-order (oldest first), matching data-model.md's Ordering section? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK006 Are the distinct rejection conditions for an invalid title (empty vs. whitespace-only vs. over-length) each stated so they can be tested independently, rather than bundled into one general rule? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK007 Do spec.md's Assumptions and plan.md's Constitution Check agree that this feature has no authentication/authorization concept at all? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §Constitution Check]
- [ ] CHK008 Are the success/error response-envelope expectations that plan.md's contracts introduce also reflected back into spec.md's functional requirements (FR-003, FR-006, FR-007), or only introduced during planning? [Consistency, Traceability]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK009 Can each of SC-001 through SC-006 be verified purely from user-observable behavior (e.g., "within 1 second" measured from the user's action), without needing implementation knowledge? [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria]
- [ ] CHK010 Is there a measurable acceptance criterion for the empty-list state (FR-004), or only a qualitative description ("clear empty-list state")? [Gap, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK011 Does every acceptance scenario (Given/When/Then) under each user story trace back to at least one functional requirement, with none left unaccounted for? [Traceability, Spec §User Scenarios]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK012 Are concurrent-modification scenarios covered beyond the single "already deleted in another tab" edge case — e.g., two simultaneous adds, or a simultaneous toggle and delete of the same todo? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK013 Are recovery requirements defined for a failed add/toggle/delete (e.g., a database error mid-operation), or only the happy path and the not-found case? [Gap, Exception Flow]
- [ ] CHK014 Does the spec state whether duplicate titles across different todos are allowed or should be prevented? [Gap, Spec §Key Entities]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK015 Are data-durability expectations specified beyond "persists across sessions" — e.g., is any data loss on an unexpected crash acceptable? [Gap, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK016 Does the spec state whether accessibility requirements (e.g., keyboard operation of add/toggle/delete) are in scope or explicitly excluded? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the planning-stage scale assumption ("tens to a few hundred todos") reflected anywhere in the spec's own requirements, or only introduced in plan.md? [Consistency, Plan §Technical Context]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK018 Is the assumption "no confirmation prompt before deleting a todo" validated as an acceptable user experience, or only asserted as a convenient default? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK019 Is the plan-level dependency on file-based SQLite storage reconciled with spec.md staying technology-agnostic, with no contradiction about how persistence is guaranteed? [Consistency, Plan §Constitution Check]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK020 Is there a single canonical term for the feature's core object across all documents — spec.md says "todo," while the API resource path is `/api/tasks`? [Ambiguity, Spec vs. Plan/Contracts]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
